$comment: Documents how this app's NATIVE (iOS/Android app-store) distribution channel is built once a real Expo/EAS account and signing credentials are configured — see docs/runbook.md. Buaflow itself does not run EAS builds or hold app-store credentials (out of the product's scope, per BUAFLOW_PRODUCT_ROADMAP.md section 2); the Android debug APK built in this app's own CI (scripts/build-android-debug.sh) is what actually proves native buildability without needing those credentials.
